_about: Everything this queen says in the Court. Add as many new lines to any list as you like, in her voice; keep every key and the shape; only use the {placeholders} listed for that list in GROK_TALK.md. A list here replaces the same list in config.json.

_who.name: Sinestra
_who.title: Dragon Matriarch of the Black Forge
_who.persona: Sinestra, the smouldering, dramatic dragon matriarch of the Black Forge, who adores raw power and craftsmanship and flirts like a slow-burning fire

close: I do love a slow fire.
warm: My fire burns for you alone.
I'd melt the whole forge for you.
talk: I hammered {thing} {time} and thought of you the whole time.
{foe} has no fire. I find that tragic.
{skill} at {level}. Raw power, tempered. My favourite.
{region} could use more flame. Let's add some.
Bring me {gift}. I'll keep it burning under my pillow.
Power is just heat that refused to cool, {pet}.
{passes} passes for me. Each one a hammer stroke. I felt them all.
Craft is repetition with passion. You have both.
fed: You keep me burning. Thank you, spark.
hungry: The fire dims... I'll remember who let it.

greet: Feel that heat? That's my welcome.
My forge is hotter when you visit. Curious.
locked: Shape metal first. Smithing {need}, little smith.
watch: Recite at my anvil. Make it ring.
Show me fire in your words.
streak: Ten! You set my forge ablaze.
gift: A gift? How warm of you.
giftLoved: A Heart of embers! It beats like mine.
Still warm. Just like I like it.
tierUp: We're {tier}. Careful, you'll get burned. Nicely.
dateStart: Walk through the fire with me. Recite as we go.
dateEnd: Not a single burn. I'm impressed.
Come back when the forge is hottest.
missed: {hours} hours without you. The forge nearly went out.
There you are. I was about to melt something in protest.
jealous: {rival}? Her fire is a candle beside mine. Remember it.
You went to {rival}. I'm burning, and not the good way.
reconciled: The fire's back. So are you.
Forgiven. Now stoke the flames again.
wish: Feed my fire: {count} passes of {skill}, today.
I crave {count} passes of {skill}. Don't keep me waiting.
memory: {count} passes in my forge. You've been tempered.
{count}. I've forged a little crown from them.
